lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs arranged in distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, forming a semi-regular 2D grid with horizontal and vertical spacing roughly equivalent to blob diameter.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs, creating a structural matrix where blobs serve as nodes within the vertical stripe pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear feature running horizontally across the superior third of the visible flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with a light-toned upper edge and shadow-defined lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Observation of a sharp spatial frequency transition in skin patterning, with high-density micro-spots on the cranial region shifting to lower-density macro-blobs on the lateral trunk.
